newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Jan-May budget deficit widens yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Jan-May budget deficit widens yr/yr.

text.p: Portugal's budget deficit between January and May rose 4.6 percent to 204.5 billion escudos between January and May 1997, compared with the same year-ago period, the Directorate-General of the Budget said.
It said in a statement that, taking into account swings in spending requirements from month to month, the budget was in line with targets set in the 1997 budget.

Portuguese tax receipts rose a nominal 12 percent year-on-year in the first five months of 1997 to 1.62 trillion escudos, although the rise was nine percent when special factors were taken into account, the Finance Ministry said earlier.
These special factors represented differences in the timings of certain tax payments compared with 1996, it added.
